runtimeIdentifiers.reason: The Azure SRE Agent definition file. ADR-0001 confines it to the binding layer; a core artifact that named it would bind the contract to one runtime.

selfExclusions.reason: This file must spell out the identifiers it forbids in order to forbid them. Excluding it is the same shape as the denylist disclosure problem in ADR-0006, resolved here by exact path rather than a pattern, so the exemption cannot widen silently.
Describes the structure of the declaration above, including the field that carries the forbidden terms.
